主要内容: Kia America reported October 2021 sales of 52,067 units, surpassing 2020's annual volume with two months remaining. Hybrid and battery-electric vehicle sales rose 91% year-over-year. Eric Watson, vice president of sales operations, noted strong demand for new Kia vehicles, despite ongoing supply chain issues and chip shortages. The company introduced the fifth-generation Sportage SUV, updated the 2022 Forte compact sedan, and named the Kia EV6 and Seltos as finalists for Green Car awards. Kia America continues to top automotive quality surveys and is recognized as one of the 100 Best Global Brands.
